cross_reference: betonai.net AI Pricing Watch 2026 (confirms on-prem cost ~= GPU-hour equivalent)
derivation: per-token rate = GPU $/sec / measured single-stream throughput (tok/s) on the live vLLM 0.17.0 servers; prefill throughput -> P_in, decode throughput -> P_out
throughput_regime: single-stream (concurrency 1) — deterministic, reproducible, conservative (highest per-token cost). Batched serving would lower P_out and raise P_in/P_out; recorded as a documented modeling choice.

dollar_grid_usd.basis: c_j = P_out(Qwen) * B_j for B_j in {512,1024,2048,4096}

consequence_note: P_in/P_out ~= 0.004 (input ~250x cheaper than output). Input cost is therefore negligible for MGSM's short prompts, so the matched-dollar frame nearly coincides with the matched-token frame. This affects only H3 (dollar-frame crossover) and the dollar deliverable table; H1/H2 (token-vs-FLORES) do not use the price snapshot at all.
